jobs.notes: Firm's official early careers page states applications are currently closed and will open 'in June' for the 2027/28 seasonal clerkship program (penultimate-year students), with a pre-registration option — no exact opening or closing dates are published yet, so both are null rather than guessed; note that as at 19 Sep 2026 every 2026/27 clerkship window I could verify (NSW: opened 10 Jun 2026, closed 5/12 Jul 2026; VIC/LIV: 6 Jul – 9 Aug 2026; QLD: mid-Jul – early Aug 2026; WA: late Jun – late Jul 2026; Legal Services Commission SA: 3–30 Aug 2026) had already closed, and no 2027-cycle Law Society schedules had yet been published, so nothing else met the 'currently open or confirmed future open date' test.
